correctness.rationale: Proof identifies exactly 234 rank-three independent triples, builds a unimodular 66-boundary-column section of the integral 1-cycle lattice, and obtains free H2 of rank 168. For all 234 oriented quadrangle cycles, exact 168x234 R has modular ranks 168 at p=2 and 165 at p=3, an exact integer maximal minor -27, and Smith invariant factors 1^165 and 3^3. Rank loss modulo 3 and exact determinant prove the quotient is exactly (Z/3)^3. Every possible four-vertex 2-cycle was classified, and PGL3(3) transitivity follows from ordered frame uniqueness. Full standalone verification input/output included.
